summary: Iter 24 — verified uniform revision badge/progress feature across Design Requests (MD), R&D Sample, and Meja MD. Backend pytest (4 tests) all green; frontend Playwright end-to-end covering board cards, list rows, detail panel, sample detail per supplier×jenis, and Meja MD queue rows — all expected testids and texts present. No regressions in Permintaan Desain / R&D Sample screens (open/close detail, no console errors, no React crash).
verified_scenarios: GET /api/design-requests?entity_id=ent_ksc returns items with integer revision_count; dsr_a623af63e8e1 has revision_count>=1.
GET /api/design-requests/dsr_a623af63e8e1 returns history with delivered events (source data for rounds).
GET /api/md/desk queues 'desain' and 'sample' include revision_count on rows; queues 'pr' and 'acuan' do NOT include revision_count.
UI Board: 4 dsr-card-* cards rendered, each with dsr-card-revision-<id>. dsr_a623af63e8e1 badge = 'Revisi ke-1'; others 'Pengajuan awal'.
UI List (Daftar): 4 rows, each with dsr-row-revision-<id>; target row = 'Revisi ke-1'.
UI Detail panel (dsr_a623af63e8e1): dsr-detail-revision='Revisi ke-1', dsr-rounds-progress present with dsr-round-1 (Pengajuan awal · Direvisi) and dsr-round-2 (Revisi 1 · ACC).
UI Detail (dsr_c41b389c72ed / delivered): 1 round box 'Pengajuan awal · Menunggu penilaian'.
UI Detail (dsr_9634f7897b6c / in_progress): 1 round box 'Pengajuan awal · Sedang dikerjakan'.
UI Detail (dsr_c53415573e5f / submitted): no dsr-rounds-progress present (correct).
R&D Samples: 28 rows each with rnd-sample-revision-<id>; KSC/SMP-00003 badge='Revisi ke-1'; other samples 'Pengajuan awal'.

R&D Sample detail (smp_127bfe1df941): sample-detail-revision='Revisi ke-1'; 2 sample-rounds-progress-* blocks (Cirebon Craft labdip and NTT Weaving labdip), with sample-round-box-* rounds 1 (ACC) and 1-Direvisi + 2-ACC respectively.

Meja MD: md-desk-queue-desain rows expose md-desk-revision-<dsr_id> (4 badges — dsr_a623af63e8e1='Revisi ke-1', others='Pengajuan awal'); md-desk-queue-sample exposes 5+ badges (smp_127bfe1df941='Revisi ke-1'); md-desk-queue-pr and md-desk-queue-acuan have NO revision badges (correct).
critical_code_review_comments: RevisionProgress.jsx is compact and cleanly shared across modules — good DRY. Consider adding a unit test for designRequestRounds() logic (delivered opens round; revision/approved closes; trailing draft for revision→in_progress) since it powers UI in multiple views.
Meja MD payload key: /api/md/desk returns a list of queues (each with id + rows), not a dict; existing consumer works but frontend/other test agents should be aware.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo data (dsr_a623af63e8e1, dsr_c41b389c72ed, dsr_9634f7897b6c, dsr_c53415573e5f, smp_127bfe1df941).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Uniform revision badge/progress feature (RevisionBadge + RoundBoxes shared component) is fully wired across Permintaan Desain (kartu, daftar, detail), R&D Sample (list, detail per supplier×jenis), and Meja MD (queues desain + sample only). Backend /api/md/desk enriches only 'desain' and 'sample' rows with revision_count. All expected testids stable: dsr-card-<id>, dsr-card-revision-<id>, dsr-row-<id>, dsr-row-revision-<id>, dsr-detail-revision, dsr-rounds-progress, dsr-round-<n>, rnd-sample-row-<id>, rnd-sample-revision-<id>, rnd-sample-open-<id>, sample-detail-panel, sample-detail-revision, sample-rounds-progress-<supplier>-<type>, sample-round-box-<supplier>-<type>-<n>, md-desk-queue-<id>, md-desk-revision-<ref_id>.
